title: Optimised Visuals
description: With this modpack installed, the game looks way better. It has sharper lighting and improves textures. Plus, it gives your performance a good solid boost too.
body: This modpack doesnt just makes your game look better, but it also improves fps by a lot. In Optimised Visuals, that game has better looking lightning, clearer textures, and areas that look really cool. Also this amazing modpack gives a lot of fps and reduces lag and ping by a lot. The FPS and visuals go together nicely because smoother frames make all the lighting, textures, effects and more look cleaner and cool. [Use also a different modpack named -Unbeatable Peformance for an amazing amount of fps and game speed] [WAY MORE THAN WHAT FPS THIS MODPACK GIVES]
